crossRefs.note: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might…
You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

translations.web: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
translations.bsb: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.
translations.kjv: Now some are puffed up, as though I would ➔ not come to you.
translations.asv: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
